name: ProTracker
description: The original ProTracker 2.3A playroutine on an emulated Amiga, locked to the project tempo and position. A mixer pans each channel, the window edits the position list, the steps of a pattern and the samples with their loops.
credits: ProTracker 2.3A playroutine by Peter "Crayon" Hanning / Mushroom Studios, 1992, public domain. Musashi 68000 emulator by Karl Stenerud (MIT). CLAP headers by free-audio (MIT). Example modules CC0.
